text: This traffic jam has no cause.
It starts with one driver, tapping the brakes, for just a second.
The car behind reacts a little late, and brakes a little harder.
Then the next one brakes even harder.
The slowdown travels backwards, growing like a wave.
Until, far behind, cars come to a complete stop, while the first driver is long gone.
Scientists call this a phantom traffic jam.
The fix? Keep a bigger gap, and ease off instead of braking.
One calm driver can swallow the entire wave.
